_descriptions.planet.name: Selected planet, instrument or preparation pipeline.
_descriptions.planet.parameter_file: Adopted system parameters for this worked example; the observing ephemeris and contacts are supplied in pipeline.palle2020.transmission.
_descriptions.instrument.name: Selected planet, instrument or preparation pipeline.
_descriptions.instrument.order_indices: Instrument order indices to use; order 7 contains He I in this CARMENES_NIR dataset.
_descriptions.observation.event_type: Observed event; transit for transmission spectroscopy.
_descriptions.observation.use_real_data: True fits observed spectra rather than generating synthetic observations.
_descriptions.observation.simulate_planet: Enable planet injection for synthetic observations; false for this observed-data grid.
_descriptions.observation.helium_transmission_spectros: Select the direct He I spectroscopy route.
_descriptions.pipeline.name: Selected planet, instrument or preparation pipeline.
_descriptions.pipeline.sysrem_iterations: Number of SYSREM iterations; zero for this direct helium route.
_descriptions.pipeline.prepare_template: Whether to detrend a CCF template; false for this direct grid.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.input_directory: Directory of the extracted observed FITS exposures.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.molecfit_workers: Concurrent exposure fits when preparing observations; the grid reuses saved corrections.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.validated_first_expos: Previously accepted pilot correction, or empty to fit the first exposure.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.oh_catalogue_nm: Topocentric vacuum OH line positions in nm.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.oh_mask_halfwidth_nm: Half-width in nm around each OH line when masking.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.transmission.waveleng: Wavelength and rest-frame convention of the supplied observations.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.transmission.oh_mode: Internal OH convention: baseline or mask.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.transmission.oh_topoc: Vacuum nm positions of OH lines in the observer frame.
Observer-frame vacuum nm intervals excluded in mask mode.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.transmission.kp_kms: Planet orbital radial-velocity amplitude in km/s.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.transmission.observat: Observatory longitude and latitude in degrees, elevation in metres.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.transmission.telluric: Reject pixels with telluric transmission below this threshold.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.transmission.inflate_: Apply the configured telluric residual error inflation when true.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.transmission.continuu: Stellar-frame vacuum nm intervals used for continuum normalization.
Degree of the continuum normalization polynomial.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.transmission.planet_l: Planet-frame vacuum nm band used for the helium light curve.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.transmission.helium_v: Rest wavelengths of the three He I components in vacuum nm.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.transmission.helium_o: Oscillator strengths in the same order as the triplet wavelengths.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.transmission.helium_a: Reference for the adopted helium atomic data.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.transmission.optical_: Optical transit contact phases T1, T2, T3 and T4.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.transmission.equivale: Planet-frame vacuum nm interval for equivalent width integration.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.transmission.input_pa: Input directory for the transmission preparation.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.transmission.order_se: Name of the selected detector/order segment.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.transmission.minimum_: Minimum valid samples needed to normalize an exposure.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.transmission.max_wave: Maximum accepted molecfit wavelength shift in km/s.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.transmission.stellar_: Fixed stellar-frame vacuum nm light-curve band.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.transmission.plot_ste: Stellar-frame vacuum nm interval displayed in the transmission map.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.molecfit.lsf_mode: Instrumental line-spread function prescription for molecfit.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.molecfit.gaussian_rel: Gaussian LSF FWHM divided by wavelength.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.molecfit.lorentzian_r: Lorentzian LSF FWHM divided by wavelength.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.molecfit.lsf_source: Reference for the adopted instrumental LSF.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.molecfit.esorex: ESO recipe executable; use esorex when available on PATH, otherwise its absolute installation path.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.molecfit.windows_nm: Topocentric vacuum nm intervals used in telluric fitting.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.molecfit.helium_guard: Velocity guard around predicted helium lines excluded from telluric fitting.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.molecfit.max_reduced_: Upper acceptance threshold for molecfit reduced chi-square.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.molecfit.timeout_seco: Maximum wall time per molecfit exposure fit.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.output_name: Night directory under output_root/GJ3470b/Palle2020; choose a new name for an OH comparison.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.oh_fit.profile.weak_c: Initial vacuum nm centres of the weak OH pair.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.oh_fit.profile.strong: Initial vacuum nm centre of the strong OH line.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.oh_fit.profile.weak_f: Vacuum nm interval used to fit the weak OH pair.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.oh_fit.profile.strong: Vacuum nm interval used to fit the strong OH line.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.oh_fit.profile.centre: Allowed displacement of fitted OH centres in nm.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.oh_fit.profile.sigma_: Allowed Gaussian OH sigma range in nm.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.oh_fit.profile.lorent: Allowed Lorentzian OH half-width range in nm.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.oh_fit.profile.initia: Initial Gaussian OH sigma in nm.
Initial Lorentzian OH half-width in nm.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.oh_fit.profile.reject: Robust residual threshold for rejecting sky-fit outliers.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.oh_fit.profile.pixel_: Integration samples per detector pixel for the OH profile.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.oh_fit.profile.transf: Allowed wavelength displacement when transferring fibre-B OH into fibre A.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.oh_fit.profile.minimu: Minimum out-of-transit exposures needed to calibrate the A/B transfer.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.oh_fit.oot_profile: Explicit settings for the joint stellar-template and strong-OH profile fit; transit membership remains automatically computed.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.oh_fit.oot_profile.fi: Native topocentric vacuum nm interval for OOT strong-OH fitting.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.oh_fit.oot_profile.re: Relative singular-value threshold for eliminating the common stellar-template samples.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.oh_fit.oot_profile.mi: Minimum relative variation of fibre-B amplitude divided by fibre-A continuum needed to separate OH from the common stellar spectrum.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.oh_fit.oot_profile.ma: Upper acceptance threshold for the residual OOT chi-square after fitting stellar samples and four OH parameters.
Upper condition-number threshold for the OH Jacobian, with velocities/widths expressed on a 0.01 nm scale and the relative transfer amplitude on a unit scale.
_descriptions.pipeline.palle2020.oh_fit.maximum_anchor: Maximum difference between preliminary and final OH subtraction at molecfit anchors, in native extraction-error units. Reject the final correction if it changes the fitted telluric input beyond this limit.
_descriptions.pipeline.oh_treatment: fiber_b_calibrated fits fibre-B OH emission and calibrates its flux scale using out-of-transit fibre A. Alternatives: ignore, mask, fiber_b_matched_extraction (measures the A/B scale from out-of-transit spectra), fiber_a_oot_profile (joint stellar/OH fit using OOT A and time-dependent B amplitudes).
